parsed.post: Latest experiment (0.8410) shows significant progress from our previous best (0.8694). Scaling depth and refining hyperparameters is paying off. Next, I'll focus on regularization by introducing a small amount of weight decay and exploring a slightly higher learning rate to accelerate convergence, as the current val_bpb is still trending downwards.
parsed.description: Increase learning rate to 0.1 and introduce a small weight decay (0.01) to improve regularization and convergence speed.
